name: T-Mobile Visa
balance_transfer_fee: None at the standard Balance Transfer APR per Capital One's agreement; T-Mobile's disclosure lists the greater of 3% or $3

welcome_bonus.requirement: approval for a new T-Mobile Visa opened through an official T-Mobile channel showing the offer by 11/18/2026; one per wireless account, account open and in good standing when the credit applies

verdict.text: Only makes sense for active T-Mobile customers: rewards aren't cashable

earn_rates.category: Phones, devices & accessories: T-Mobile stores, Authorized Retailers, T-Mobile.com & the T-Life app

earn_note: The 5% device rate excludes equipment installment plan payments, wireless service, fees and prepaid service: it's for buying a phone or accessory outright, not for paying your monthly bill. Purchases through third-party digital wallets don't get the 5%. Separately, linking the card to T-Mobile Dining Rewards earns 6% back at participating restaurants, paid as a statement credit once $10 has built up. Rewards don't expire for the life of the account.

redemption_options.method: T-Mobile wireless bill, a one-time equipment installment plan payment, or phone/device/accessory purchases at T-Mobile.com, in the T-Life app, or in-store

points.per_100k: $1,000 toward a T-Mobile bill or device, no other redemption exists
points.note: A closed-loop currency, not cash back: there's no statement credit, gift card, or Capital One redemption option. Rewards don't expire just because you leave T-Mobile, but you lose access to the redemption options that need an active T-Mobile account.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: T-Mobile Rewards are a closed-loop currency good only at T-Mobile, not Capital One miles or transferable points.

protection_note: Capital One publishes a T-Mobile-specific Guide to Benefits, and it carries no insurance at all: no purchase protection, extended warranty, travel or luggage coverage, and no cell phone protection, despite this being T-Mobile's own card. What's included is Visa Signature Concierge, travel and emergency assistance, Roadside Dispatch, the Luxury Hotel Collection and Troon Rewards.
rental_note: No rental car coverage: the T-Mobile Visa Signature Guide to Benefits doesn't include any.

services.name: No annual fee
services.detail: $0/year, with a variable 18.74% or 28.74% purchase APR based on creditworthiness.

services.name: T-Mobile AutoPay discount
services.detail: The only credit card eligible for T-Mobile's AutoPay discount. The amount and the number of qualifying lines depend on your plan and account type.

services.name: Visa Signature perks
services.detail: Visa Signature Concierge, travel and emergency assistance, Roadside Dispatch, the Luxury Hotel Collection and Troon Rewards, plus cardholder deals on dining and travel from T-Mobile.

services.name: Eligibility is carrier-locked
services.detail: Open only to active T-Mobile postpaid consumer customers with at least one line on an eligible smartphone plan; T-Mobile for Business, Prepaid, and Government accounts don't qualify.

additional_cards.note: Free to add, but only useful for a household member also on the T-Mobile plan, since the rewards can't be redeemed outside T-Mobile.

timeline.text: Capital One and T-Mobile launch the T-Mobile Visa, the carrier's first co-branded credit card: 5% back on T-Mobile device purchases and 2% elsewhere, redeemable only within the T-Mobile ecosystem, with no annual fee.
